name: Hunyuan-A13B-Instruct
context_scaling: dynamic NTK (rope_scaling type dynamic, factor 1.0, alpha 1000)
attention_variant: GQA (standard; no MLA - kv_lora_rank explicitly null)
license: Tencent Hunyuan A13B bespoke license (not OSI)
notes: Tencent's fine-grained MoE. The name is the active count: vendor states 13B active out of 80B total; safetensors total 80.39B. Our config arithmetic gives 75.6B total / 12.1B active, matching the active figure to ~7% (the gap is the tied-embedding handling and the per-layer moe_topk/shared-expert arrays). kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 32 layers x 8 kv_heads x head_dim 128 x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes (bf16) = 32 x 8 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 131,072 B/token (128 KiB). GQA, not MLA - config sets kv_lora_rank, q_lora_rank, qk_nope_head_dim and v_head_dim all to null, so the latent path is absent. For 13B active that is high KV, though the window is small. MoE: 64 experts, moe_topk 8, PLUS 1 shared expert per layer (num_shared_expert is a 32-element array of 1s), and the first 2 layers are dense (dense_list [4096, 0]). moe_intermediate_size 3072 equals intermediate_size, hidden 4096, gqa_ratio 4 (32 heads / 8 kv heads), vocab 128167, tie_word_embeddings true. CONTEXT DISCREPANCY, recorded rather than resolved: the card says the model supports 256K tokens but config max_position_embeddings is 32768, and the card explicitly attributes the lower default to GPU memory constraints. rope_scaling type is 'dynamic' with factor 1.0 and alpha 1000, rope_theta 10000. Licence is bespoke: license_name tencent-hunyuan-a13b, with commercial conditions in the Tencent Hunyuan repo. Not OSI.
